title: All the Way Up, and On a Calendar
label: ch:ta-ordinals-to-eleventh
canDo: I can say sixth to eleventh in Tamil, make the ordinal of any number I know, and say a date with the ending a calendar uses.

payoff.summary: Eleven ordinals and two endings retrieved out of order, with three ordinals made for numbers no lesson taught and three dates said with the calendar ending.
